name: Aichun Beauty Beard Growth Solution Oil for Men 30ml
description:
Beard Growth Solution Oil for Men 30ml 
This oil is enriched with multiple natural nourishing ingredients that infiltrate into the hair follicle roots, repair & activate the dormant hair follicles, in-crease nutrient absorption and accelerate hair growth. 
Made of good quality natural material, safe to use. Small size and portable, suitable for traveling. 
Effectively make your beard growth fast, can draw the lines of your beard as you like. 
Working as a softener and conditioner at the same time, this great beard oil offers deep moisturizing, curing your brittle, weak and scratchy beard. Even after the first use your beard will be more manageable and way softer. 
Perfect as gift to your boyfriend, husband, father and friends.
